claims.quote: Pathogenic variants of voltage-gated potassium channels have been associated with epilepsy of variable severity. These include the sodium-activated potassium channel subfamily T member 2 (KCNT2) gene
the sodium-activated potassium channel subfamily T member 2 (KCNT2) gene, which encodes for pore-forming alpha subunits.
KCNT2 gene mutations have been recently described to cause developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs).
